input.quote: Client will be provided upon request with documentation supporting the amount charged (other than the minimum monthly fees listed in Section 4) and will be entitled to contest any charge
input.rationale: There is no audit, inspection or usage-verification right running against Client; the only information rights run in our favour (supporting documentation for charges) and the access reference in Section 9 is limited to letting TrueLink make its own Y2K repairs. Preferred position met, no redline.

input.quote: Invoices will be paid within 15 days of receipt.
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalty interest, stipulated penalties or termination charges are payable by Client — the anti-spam covenant in Section 7 and the enforcement right in Section 8(f) carry no monetary penalty, and there is no early-termination fee. The monthly minimum fees are addressed separately under MINCOMMIT. No redline.
